symptom: `describe workflow M.WF_Parent` printed `call workflow M.WF_Child;` for a call stored with `(WorkflowContext = $WorkflowContext/M.Parent_Current/M.Item)`; re-executing the describe output reported "Modified workflow" and mx check went from 0 errors to CE0117 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1531).
cause: The gen->sdk reader's CallWorkflowActivity case copied Workflow, ParameterExpression and BoundaryEvents but never ParameterMappingsItems(); describe's workflowCallArguments prints mappings when populated, so it had nothing to print. On re-exec, autoBindCallWorkflow saw no mapping and wrote the default `$WorkflowContext` - the parent's context object, not the associated child object.
file: mdl/backend/modelsdk/workflow_read.go (workflowParamMappingsFromGen, twin of microflowParamMappingsFromGen, wired into the CallWorkflowActivity case)
insight: The call-microflow cases had the identical gap fixed earlier (FINDINGS #42) and the call-workflow case right below them was not touched - when one arm of a type switch gains a property read, diff it against its siblings. The describe tests build semantic structs directly, so the reader layer had no coverage; the test that catches this goes writer -> gen -> reader (roundTripWorkflowActivity). The silent part is the auto-bind default, not the drop: a missing mapping is re-filled with a plausible one. Measured on 11.15.0: pre-fix round trip CE0117, fixed round trip prints "Unchanged workflow" and 0 errors. Side measurement: `$WorkflowContext/M.Parent_Current` (no target entity) is CE0117 on 11.15.0 as on 11.6.6 - not a version difference, the path must name the target entity.
